notes.title: DevLog: Better queue management in floors
notes.notes:
Before this update, it used to be hard to come up with a proper strategy, as passengers waiting in a floor would randomly get into the elevator.

With this update, the passengers waiting in line will now respect the order in which they arrived. So first come, first served! This makes it much more predictable to setup your elevator strategy by looking into the state of each floor. Thanks amamam for the feedback!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/QHc2l5k.gif[/img]
